title: 12 Angry Men
favouriteScene: The moment Juror 10 delivers his bigoted tirade and one by one, every juror silently turns their back on him.
favouritePerformance: Henry Fonda as Juror 8 & Lee J. Cobb as Juror 3
personalReflections: Confined to a sweltering room, Lumet constructs a breathtaking study of human psychology. It demonstrates that true drama does not need explosions; it needs characters who believe they are right.
